label: Save Asset
description: Store text, a file or an image in the Asset Library so it is kept, searchable and traceable.

inputs.name: in
inputs.label: Content
inputs.description: Text, an object, a file path, a data URI or an existing asset.

inputs.name: name
inputs.label: Name Override
inputs.description: Overrides the configured asset name at runtime.

outputs.name: path
outputs.label: File Path
outputs.description: Local path of the stored file.

outputs.name: error
outputs.label: Error
outputs.description: Error message if the step failed. Wire it to handle failures yourself; leave it unwired and the node fails visibly instead.
